verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own receipt handling. The product page claims "auto-receipt capture at the moment of card swipe," Ramp's AI page says it automates "collecting receipts," and the official CLI ships a receipts resource with upload/attach commands. However, nothing shows that a receipt that is emailed or uploaded gets automatically matched to the right transaction; the CLI attach command may require naming the transaction yourself. missing for 10: documented email-forwarding receipt intake, explicit automatic matching of uploaded receipts to transactions, independent or hands-on corroboration of receipt matching.
